summary: Tuya Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for FY2025 (December 31, 2025 year-end) with the SEC and the release of its Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Report. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or corporate action is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic reporting obligation of a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. domestic filer's Form 10-K annual report filing. No deal terms, prices, stakes, or structural changes are present. What to watch: This is a compliance filing; no special situation or event-driven angle applies.
